spine.active_goal: Make Build A actually work. The merge-boundary preflight is merged to main (PR #5, 457d6fa) but INERT: it halts every mitosis run until the runbook's GitHub-side setup is applied. Get it live, and clear the SAST residue the pin re-adjudication deliberately deferred.
spine.next_step: START HERE, no human needed: apply runbook Section 6 per 0045 -- add `edited` to the `pull_request` trigger's `types:` list on the PR-gating workflow. .github/workflows/security.yml:3-5 has the bare `on: pull_request:` hazard; before/after at runbook Section 6, lines 129-146. Ship it as its own PR. IN PARALLEL, ask the human for Sections 2-5 (machine user, PAT with Actions:Read, ruleset, merge strategy) -- GitHub account actions no agent can perform.
open_risks: Build A is shipped but INERT. Until Sections 2-5 are human-applied, the preflight halts every mitosis run, so nothing downstream can be exercised end-to-end.
A green diff-aware CI check is NOT proof main is clean (0044). CI is diff-aware on pushes to main with a resolvable baseline; re-run the no-baseline full-repo scan before any 'main is clean' claim.

Section 6 caveat from the runbook itself: the nested key names under `changes.base` in the `edited` webhook payload are `[unverified]` and need a live-payload check at apply time. The fix depends only on the docs-verified fact that `edited` fires on retarget, which is enough to proceed.

Re-verify suites with `node --test <dir>/*.test.mjs`. A bare directory fails MODULE_NOT_FOUND on Node 26 and LOOKS like a real test failure. No node_modules exists or is needed. A pre-commit hook already runs the full suite (1217 tests) on every commit.

The p/default pin is HASH-ONLY -- content was never vendored -- so the next upstream drift forces a from-scratch pragma re-adjudication with no diff to read. Budget for it; do not treat a drift failure as a quick bump.
Section 6's fix belongs on whichever workflow actually gates PRs. Confirm that surface before editing; do not assume security.yml is the only one.
Decision numbering is global across threads and NOT contiguous. Disambiguate by SLUG, never by number.

Worktrees .claude/worktrees/semgrep-pin and .claude/worktrees/boundary-preflight hold fully-merged branches and are prunable, but squash-merge means `git branch --merged` will not list them. Cleanup is destructive; offered, NOT performed.
